<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$d1Root = '/workspace/scratch/8dccbfa10ffb/parameters-audit/d1-integration';
$_SERVER['COLLISION_PRINTER'] = 'DefaultPrinter';
require $d1Root . '/vendor/autoload.php';
$d1Sources = [
    Componenta\DI\ContainerFactory::class => 'src/ContainerFactory.php',
    Componenta\DI\Container::class => 'src/Container.php',
    Componenta\DI\ProxyFactory::class => 'src/ProxyFactory.php',
    Componenta\DI\Object\ObjectPipeline::class => 'src/Object/ObjectPipeline.php',
    Componenta\DI\Resolver\Attribute\Handler\MakeHandler::class => 'src/Resolver/Attribute/Handler/MakeHandler.php',
    Componenta\DI\Tests\Support\ContainerBuilder::class => 'tests/Support/ContainerBuilder.php',
];
$d1Records = [];
foreach ($d1Sources as $d1Class => $d1Relative) {
    $d1Origin = (new ReflectionClass($d1Class))->getFileName();
    if ($d1Origin === false || realpath($d1Origin) !== realpath($d1Root . '/' . $d1Relative)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('D1 check must load the isolated source: ' . $d1Class);
    }
    $d1Records[$d1Class] = ['file' => $d1Origin, 'sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $d1Origin)];
}
fwrite(STDERR, 'D1_SOURCE_GUARD ' . json_encode(['php_version' => PHP_VERSION, 'php_binary' => PHP_BINARY, 'origins' => $d1Records], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) . PHP_EOL);

from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time

phase, version = sys.argv[1:]
root = Path('/workspace/scratch/8dccbfa10ffb/parameters-audit')
repo = root / 'd1-integration'
out = root / 'evidence/d1-integration'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
name = f'{phase}-php{version}'
command = [f'/workspace/scratch/8f6c1df8ef3b/runtime/php{version}/php', '-n', '-d', f'auto_prepend_file={root / "d1-source-guard.php"}', 'vendor/bin/pest', 'tests/Contract/PropertylessLazyLifecycleContractTest.php', '--compact', '--colors=never', '--order-by=default', '--do-not-cache-result']

def fingerprint():
    entries = {str(file.relative_to(repo)): hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for file in sorted((repo / 'src').rglob('*.php'))}
    return {'files': entries, 'aggregate_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(entries, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()}

before = fingerprint()
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
t = time.monotonic()
result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=repo, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
after = fingerprint()
assert before == after
log = out / (name + '.log')
log.write_bytes(result.stdout)
record = {'phase': phase, 'runtime': version, 'baseline_commit': 'fe435db72d60fc3b042f1a5def815bf1fdb91980', 'cwd': str(repo), 'command': command, 'started_at': started, 'seconds': time.monotonic() - t, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'expected_exit': 'nonzero' if phase.startswith('baseline') else 0, 'production_before': before, 'production_after_matches': True, 'test_file': 'tests/Contract/PropertylessLazyLifecycleContractTest.php', 'test_sha256': hashlib.sha256((repo / 'tests/Contract/PropertylessLazyLifecycleContractTest.php').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'full_log': str(log), 'log_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(), 'log_bytes': len(result.stdout)}
(out / (name + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != 'production_before'}, indent=2))
print(result.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[-6000:])
sys.exit(result.returncode)
